title: ProjectMetadata
description: Top-level config for a ledger-managed project. Lives at .ledger/project.json. Schema version 1.

schemaVersion.description: Authored explicitly by the operator; bumps on breaking schema changes.

name.description: Human-readable project name shown in the topbar.

docs.description: Relative path from the project root to the docs tree, e.g. "docs". No leading or trailing slash. Path-traversal segments (..) are NOT rejected by this schema; the API server consuming this field must treat it as untrusted operator input and reject .. segments + assert containment under the project root before any filesystem read. See 03-project-metadata Open Issues for the delegation.

agent.description: Identifier of the agent runtime used to dispatch tasks. v1 recommends "claude-code"; no enum enforced.

health.description: Health scanner thresholds. All fields optional; defaults apply when omitted.

sizeThresholdTokens.description: Estimated token count above which a doc triggers a size finding. Default: 12000.

workflow.description: Workflow script configuration. All fields optional; defaults apply when omitted.

baseBranch.description: Integration branch the workflow scripts branch from and merge into (worktree add, rebase, diff, branch --merged, merge). Default: "main".

rootDoc.description: Stem of the top-level project doc (without .md extension), e.g. "00-project". Default: "00-project".

typesEntrypoint.description: Relative path from the project root to the primary types entrypoint shown to spec reviewers. Omit to skip the types bullet in Stage 2 prompts.

apiPort.description: Port the Ledger API server listens on. Overridden by LEDGER_PORT env var. Default: 4180.

uiPort.description: Port the Ledger UI dev server listens on. Overridden by LEDGER_UI_PORT env var. Default: 4179.

gates.description: Ordered list of gate commands to run after implementation. Use {dir} as a placeholder; the script replaces it with the appropriate path (worktree or repo root) per stage.

command.description: Shell command. Use {dir} as a placeholder for the directory path.

e2eGate.description: Optional E2E gate command. Use {dir} as a placeholder. When absent, the E2E stage is skipped with e2eExit: -1.

worktreeSetup.description: Ordered list of idempotent setup steps run by the implement stage right after `git worktree add`, to populate gitignored artifacts a fresh worktree needs but lacks (e.g. symlinking .env). Use {dir} for the worktree path and {repo} for the repo root. Steps must not be committed.

command.description: Shell command. Use {dir} for the worktree path, {repo} for the repo root.

Shell command that generates an artifact for operator review from the implementation worktree. Use {dir} as a placeholder for the worktree path and {nodeId} for the node id. Run after Stage 4 (Implement), before Stage 5 (Rebase).

artifactPath.description: Optional path (may use {dir}/{nodeId} placeholders) to the artifact command produces. When omitted, the agent running command reports the path it produced.

postImplementationGate.description: Optional operator pause after implementation: runs command in the impl worktree and creates a human_review task pointing at the resulting artifact before Stage 5 (Rebase) proceeds. Absent by default — no behavior change. The artifact's nature (image, report, log) is entirely up to the configured command.
